image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, mossy surface with scattered dry leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots. Its limbs are splayed out, showing short, stout legs. The head is broad, and the skin appears wet and reflective.
